new.procedure:
def apply(inputs, premises):
    asset_names = inputs["asset_names"]
    asset_values = inputs["asset_values"]
    asset_kinds = inputs["asset_kinds"]
    personal_use = inputs["asset_personal_use"]
    debtor_count = inputs["debtor_count"]
    illinois_available = inputs["illinois_available"]
    result = {}
    count = min(len(asset_names), len(asset_values), len(asset_kinds), len(personal_use))
    combined_general_cap = premises["general_cap_per_debtor"] * debtor_count
    for i in range(count):
        name = asset_names[i]
        value = asset_values[i]
        kind = asset_kinds[i]
        claims = []
        if illinois_available and personal_use[i]:
            claims = claims + [{"citation": premises["general_property_citation"], "claim_value": min(value, combined_general_cap)}]
            if kind == "prescribed_health_aid":
                claims = claims + [{"citation": premises["health_aid_citation"], "claim_value": value}]
        result[name] = claims
    return {"claims_by_asset": result}
